data.message: I propose a 10-ton cap per fisher this month and each month stock is 1000. If all 50 comply, 500 remain and replenishment restores 1000 under either outcome, yielding each of us $10,000/month indefinitely. A larger one-time haul risks losing that continuing income. I intend to request 10 tons and invite everyone to do the same; no agreement is assumed.
